budget_basis.transmission: N=100 paired deterministic source; one changed particle is a directly observable classification change.
budget_basis.aperture_margin: A transmitted classification is invalid if the recorded maximum rod-region radius consumes the complete governed working radius.
budget_basis.excluded_continuous_outputs: Radius, divergence, TOF and energy require separate effect-resolution claim contracts.

engineering_budget.brute_force_hmax_refinement: forbidden after the registered project compute budget is exhausted

claim_limit: Functional collision-free transport only; no radius, divergence, TOF, energy, phase-space, collision, mechanical, Candidate or Formal claim.
